title: Zesty Kenyan Gosari Grill
description: A vibrant, raw-friendly Kenyan dish featuring fernbrake gosari grilled in a papillote for a velvety, zesty finish.
instructions: Preheat binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
Rinse gosari and pat dry, then cut into 2cm pieces.
Whisk together olive oil, soy sauce, lemon juice, smoked paprika, cumin, ginger, garlic, lemon zest, salt, and pepper.
Toss gosari and tofu cubes in the dressing until evenly coated.
Place a parchment sheet on a clean surface, lay foil over it, and arrange the coated gosari and tofu in a single layer.
Fold the parchment and foil into a tight papillote, sealing the edges with a twist.
Place the papillote on the preheated grill and close the lid; grill for 12 minutes, flipping once at 6 minutes.
Remove from grill, unwrap carefully, sprinkle chopped cilantro, and serve immediately.
